name: Chain of Custody Tracking
description: Every piece of physical and digital evidence needs a tamper-evident record of who collected, transferred, or accessed it and when, so it remains admissible in court.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks how evidence is logged and tracked from collection onward
Developer asks who has handled a specific piece of evidence

name: Cross-Case Linkage & Pattern Analysis
description: Detectives need the ability to surface connections between cases sharing a suspect, modus operandi, location, or victim, since these links are currently missed across disconnected spreadsheets.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks whether cases can be linked by suspect, MO, or location
Developer probes about identifying repeat offenders across cases

name: Role-Based Access Control
description: Access to case details must be restricted by role and need-to-know, so sensitive victim, informant, and investigative details aren't visible to everyone in the department.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks who should be able to see which parts of a case
Developer asks about restricting sensitive information by role

name: Immutable Audit Trail
description: Every read or edit of a case file must be permanently logged with user, timestamp, and action, since this record needs to hold up as evidence of proper handling in court and audits.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about logging who accessed or changed a record and when
Developer mentions court admissibility or audit requirements

name: Digital Evidence Storage with Integrity Verification
description: Photos, videos, and forensic reports need secure storage with a way to prove the file hasn't been altered since it was uploaded (e.g. hash verification).
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks how photos, videos, or forensic files are stored
Developer asks about proving a file hasn't been tampered with

name: Case Status Workflow & Deadline Alerts
description: Cases need to move through defined stages (open, under investigation, referred to prosecution, closed, cold) with automatic alerts before court dates or statute-of-limitations deadlines are missed.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about the stages a case moves through
Developer asks about reminders for court dates or filing deadlines

name: Multi-Agency Data Sharing Controls
description: The department occasionally needs to share specific case data with other agencies (prosecutors, neighboring departments, state databases) without exposing the full case file.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about sharing cases with other departments or agencies
Developer asks about integration with external or national databases

name: Searchable Historical Case Archive
description: Detectives need to search and retrieve closed and cold case files quickly, since old cases are currently buried in filing cabinets and rarely revisited even when relevant to a new case.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks how old or cold case files can be searched and retrieved
Developer asks how long records are kept before archiving
